headline: The night rally shipped — and its brakes got fixed the same night
lede: RALLY CO-DRIVER is live: fog, blind crests and a co-driver whose pace notes are all you know about the road ahead. A real-key drive review after the merge found the pause button broken four different ways — the hotfix lands with a 16-assertion regression drive that presses ? so CI never has to hope.

notes.text: RALLY CO-DRIVER merged for #1251 — seeded two-lap night stage, split-information co-op (CPU / shared-keys / mic pace notes), the clock is the score.

Post-merge real-drive review caught four shipped bugs in the pause path (RESUME threw, the sim ran behind the overlay, ? never fired, the overlay crashed the tree) — fixed and regression-proven by the new rallydrive check.
Nightly soak roster synced to include the rally — the same miss that red-froze main last week (#1350).
Two lanes touched one issue at once (#1258 trial growing pain): GitHub serialized the merge cleanly; the law gains a habit — copy the branch into your own lane worktree before verifying.
